changelog:
- Permanent Fix for Three-Dots & All Section Action Buttons: Fixed SVG pointer interception across all buttons with pointer-events: none, ensuring clicks never misfire or get swallowed by inner SVG paths/circles.
- Robust Popover Dismiss Logic: Upgraded document dismiss listener with closest() checks to prevent premature menu closure during touch events.
- Complete Event Handling: Added stopPropagation and vibration feedback across all popover items, command bar buttons, and 4 home essential circular discs.
- Zero Sticky Hovers on Mobile: Scoped all hover interactions to fine pointers with responsive active touch states.
